_meta.purpose: Complete dialogs. Every pattern is a Dialog node — the component brings its own Backdrop and the Popover regions.
_meta.levels: level "section" is the top-level placeable dialog. level "module" is embeddable inside another pattern and is reached via $ref.

modal.confirm.purpose: Destructive confirmation: question, consequence notification, cancel plus confirm.
modal.confirm.intent: Make the user confirm an action that cannot be undone.
modal.confirm.whenToUse: The action deletes, cancels or otherwise cannot be reverted. The primary button names the action ("Endgültig löschen"), never a bare "OK".

modal.acknowledge.purpose: Acknowledgement: a statement the user only confirms.
modal.acknowledge.intent: Inform the user about something they must acknowledge before continuing.
modal.acknowledge.whenToUse: There is nothing to decide — only one way out. Drop the secondary action entirely rather than offering a pointless "Abbrechen".

modal.input.purpose: Short input task inside a dialog: lead-in, one or two fields, cancel plus save.
modal.input.intent: Collect one or two values without leaving the current screen.
modal.input.whenToUse: A tiny form that belongs to the current context — rename, add a note, pick a date. Anything longer belongs on a form page, not in a dialog.
